events.label: June CPI (8:30 AM ET) — FactSet consensus ~3.8% YoY (range 3.75-3.90%); BUY gate requires ≤3.5%
events.note: June CPI is the summer's regime-defining binary. FactSet consensus: -0.1% MoM / ~3.8% YoY; gasoline -10% in June (ceasefire-era Hormuz reopening) drives headline step-down from 4.2% May. BTC Gate 2 BREACHED ($61,821 24h low < $62,000 floor) pre-print. Scenario A (CPI ≤3.5%): BUY upgrade activated at 9:31 AM; Gate 2 reset condition met; full NVDA/AVGO/SKHY adds; close TBT immediately. Scenario B (3.5-3.9%): STEP ASIDE maintained; muddle-through; Warsh determines next move. Scenario C (≥3.9%): BEARISH escalation; 30Y through 5.15%; reduce all longs. CRITICAL: June CPI captures pre-Hormuz-shock prices. July CPI (August BLS) carries the real pass-through from July 13 WTI +9.4% spike.

events.label: Fed Chair Warsh House Financial Services testimony (10:00 AM ET) — debut Congressional appearance; July hike probability ~50%
events.note: Warsh's first semiannual monetary policy address to Congress arrives with CPI data in hand (released 90 min prior). Fed revised 2026 inflation forecast to 3.6%. July hike probability at ~50% heading in. Key signal: any 'live July meeting' language = 30Y re-accelerates immediately. Warsh is known for avoiding forward guidance — the testimony likely won't commit explicitly. Senate Banking follows Wednesday post-PPI.

events.label: JPM, BAC, GS, WFC, C Q2 2026 earnings — ALL pre-market; JPM beat: EPS $6.14 vs $5.59 est.
events.note: JPMorgan Q2 2026 EPS $6.14 vs $5.59 consensus (+9.84% beat). All five major US banks report pre-open July 14. Key metrics: NIM direction (expanding = higher-for-longer is not recessionary; contracting = Q3 credit cycle warning), loan-loss provisions, and Dimon H2 2026 macro commentary. Options pricing 4.4-6% implied moves — do not buy before earnings call NIM/credit guidance.

events.label: June PPI (8:30 AM ET) — post-CPI producer inflation read; Warsh Senate Banking testimony
events.note: Follow-on to June CPI. MS, BLK, JNJ also report Q2 earnings. Warsh moves to Senate Banking Committee. Directional cue from Tuesday's CPI print and bank call commentary sets the tone for Wednesday's session.

events.label: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings pre-market — AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event; Netflix also reports
events.note: TSMC Q2 2026 is the most important print of the week for the AI/semis complex. Revenue guidance and H2 AI datacenter commentary is the fundamental clearing event for NVDA ($200-205 entry gate), AMD, and AVGO positioning. Retail sales data (8:30 AM ET) adds macro context for consumer health. Netflix Q2 earnings also Thursday.

events.label: TSLA Q2 2026 earnings (est.) — after market close; 480K delivery beat sets the floor
events.note: Q2 earnings follow the July 2 delivery report: 480,126 vehicles delivered (vs. 406,024 consensus; +25% YoY; best-ever Q2). Despite the blowout beat, TSLA fell ~7.49% on July 2 (sell-the-news + growth scare). Q2 earnings call (~July 22) is the fundamental clearing event: need gross margin recovery (>25%), FSD revenue recognition at scale, and Q3 delivery guide >450K for the stock to re-rate above $420. Weak gross margin (<22%) or no FSD clarity = $393 July 2 close is the near-term top.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — July hike probability elevated to ~50% post-Iran shock; CPI/Warsh July 14 determine the final odds
events.note: July hike probability rose to ~50% as of July 14 morning on Iran-driven oil inflation and 30Y above 5%. June 17 FOMC minutes confirmed: no cuts until Q2 2027; September hike probability 68.8%. The June CPI release (July 14) and Warsh's Congressional testimony (July 14-15) are the primary inputs. CPI ≤3.5% would collapse July hike probability toward 10%; CPI ≥3.9% + hawkish Warsh would confirm July hike as plausible. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh can move in either direction without political constraint.

events.label: META Q2 2026 earnings — AI cloud business first quantification; peak Q2 earnings week
events.note: META Q2 earnings July 29 is the first event where management must quantify the cloud business (Bloomberg July 1: Meta building AI cloud to sell excess compute). Q2 earnings is the first AI-at-scale quarter. GOOGL, MSFT, and AMZN also report in mid-to-late July — peak Q2 earnings risk window. ISM Services 54.0% (July 6) validates the Search and Cloud AI expansion narrative.

events.label: July CPI release (est. Aug 13) — captures full WTI +9.4% spike (Jul 13) + Hormuz blockade oil pass-through; also Iran 60-day MOU deadline
events.note: June CPI (July 14) captures pre-Hormuz-shock prices. July CPI will be the FIRST month to reflect the WTI +9.4% spike of July 13 and the ongoing Strait disruption. If the Hormuz blockade persists through late July, July CPI could surprise significantly to the upside relative to June. This is the real inflation inflection event for H2 2026. Also approximately the Iran-US 60-day MOU deadline (original Islamabad Declaration framework, now voided — but diplomatic context remains relevant for oil pricing).

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — $91B revenue guide; AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event
events.note: NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings is the fundamental clearing event for the AI capex thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. NVDA at ~$205-208 pre-market July 14; hard stop at close below $195. TSMC Q2 July 16 is the next intermediate gate. Iran chip-export risk and rate headwinds add near-term pressure. Full-size add gate: NVDA 2 consecutive closes above $210 + SPX >7,550 + VIX <17.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. SPCX Nasdaq-100 effective July 7; inclusion-day distribution confirmed at $158.77 peak. Re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn) is the fundamental clearing event after the inclusion-day distribution pattern. Lock-up expiry December 9 adds supply overhang.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. The $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories.
